## Let an assistant write it for you

Give this file to your assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, a local model), describe the figure you want, and it writes the specification for you.

::: {.gallery-actions}
<a class="download-spec" download="scigraphs-pipeline-skill.md" href="data:text/markdown;base64,">Download the assistant instructions</a>
:::

It contains the full field list plus the rules the schema alone cannot express, so the assistant produces specifications that actually validate.

Careful: the `ops` block runs arbitrary Blender operators, so read a generated file before running it.
:::
